title: coverage – register of what was searched (one search of one source)
description: A negative result is only meaningful with its ranges, name variants and method. Searching an index is not proof of absence (method/rules.md).

event.description: The kind of entries searched for (birth, marriage, death …). With the dates of the ranges it gives the legal time limit of the region (ADR 0064).

volume.description: volume searched, one of source.volumes when the source lists them (ADR 0058)

part.description: part of the book searched, as the book or portal names it: a village, a section (e.g. Ukázkov), a letter of an index

pages.description: e.g. 12-140, or images 5-88; ..-250 or images ..-250 when the first one of a part is not known

query.description: the search as typed into a database, full-text search or index (ADR 0035)

items.x-hint: each range needs dates, pages or – for a database search – query

names.description: Name variants searched for (all of them – a new variant later reopens the negative).

result.description: found / negative (searched, not there) / partial / inaccessible (access state, NOT a negative).

inquiry.description: method inquiry: the inquiry this search was made through (ADR 0036)

pointers.description: method index: what the index points to (ADR 0060). A pointer is a lead to the book, not a record and not a statement about a person – follow it and record the book search in its own coverage.

name_as_written.description: the name as the index gives it

date_as_written.description: a year or date the index gives, as written – the book decides

to.description: where the index points: the book (source) and the place in it
to.x-hint: needs at least one of page, folio, entry, image

followed.description: the coverage of the search in the book the pointer leads to

searched_by.description: Who did the search (ADR 0052): member – the member in `by` searched themselves; agent – an AI agent searched on the instruction of `by`.

agent_model.description: The model that searched, with searched_by: agent.

index_covers.description: With method index: the period the index really covers, checked in the index itself, when it differs from the archive's description (e.g. the book 1870/1950, but the index section of the letter starts in 1900: 1900/1950). Years searched outside it are not covered by this search.

index_negative_accepted.description: A negative from an index only, accepted on purpose (ADR 0040): who decided, when and why the index is enough here.
